message.mod-stella-tower.floor_cleared: Floor %s cleared! A bonus chest waits by the exit.
message.mod-stella-tower.milestone: Milestone! Floor %s reached. A chest waits beside you.
item.mod-stella-tower.floor_key.desc: Goes to its floor. A portal outside the tower leads to the higher of your best key's floor and last floor. Never spent.
item.mod-stella-tower.void_key.desc: Returns you to where you entered the tower, or to the world spawn. Never spent.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.outsid: The Void Key only works inside the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.no_ent: The Void Key does not remember where you came from.
item.mod-stella-tower.wisp.desc: Lights the way to the portal for 20 minutes. 24 uses. Hostile mobs on the lit way gain Speed II and Strength II.
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.lit: The wisp lights the way to the portal: %s steps
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.nowhere: The wisp finds no portal to lead you to here
item.mod-stella-tower.ghost_rune.desc: Set into a chestplate or weapon. Or craft a wisp from it with 2 echo shards and glowstone dust.
item.mod-stella-tower.ghosted.chest.desc: Ghost Rune: phase through mobs, slowing foes you pass; evade 30%% of blows
item.mod-stella-tower.ghosted.weapon.des: Ghost Rune: blows pierce half of armor and pass shields
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.desc: Set into a weapon, armor piece or spellbook.
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon: Weapon: hits x%1$s. The added damage is x%2$s against %3$s and x%4$s against its own element
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor: Armor: each piece divides tower blows by %1$s and cuts %2$s%% more from mobs of its own element (%3$s%% at most)
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.fire: Weapon: heat stacks; the 5th combusts for %s%% of the hit (STR).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.ice: Weapon: chills; +%s%% damage to slowed or frozen targets (INT).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.water: Weapon: soaks 5 s; +%s%% damage taken from all sources (LUK).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.lightn: Weapon: each 4th hit chains to 2 mobs in 4 blocks for %s%% (DEX).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.wind: Weapon: +%s%% damage to airborne targets, plus knockback (AGI).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.void: Weapon: shreds 2%% armor per hit, up to %s%% (INT).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.holy: Weapon: heals %s%% of damage dealt, double on undead (VIT).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.dark: Weapon: +%s%% damage to targets below 30%% health (STR).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.fire: Set: attackers burn 3 s and take %s%% of their hit (VIT).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.ice: Set: %s%% chance to freeze an attacker 1 s (AGI).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.water: Set: regenerate %s%% max health every 10 s (VIT).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.lightni: Set: hits taken store a charge (max 5); next attack +%s%% each (DEX).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.wind: Set: %s%% chance to dodge a hit (AGI).
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.dark: Set: attackers get Weakness I for %s s (LUK).
message.mod-stella-tower.guardians_rise: The bones sink into the sand. The Tower Guardians rise again.
item.mod-stella-tower.perfect_invisibili: For a minute no mob sees you, the undead included. A blow you strike reveals you for 10 seconds.
item.mod-stella-tower.soul_tonic.desc: Heals you in full and grants Regeneration III for 30 seconds.
item.mod-stella-tower.phantom_arrow.desc: A spectral arrow that pierces two bodies after the first.
item.mod-stella-tower.ghost_lantern.desc: Gives full light. Makes invisible mobs within 16 blocks glow. Works held in either hand.
item.mod-stella-tower.ectoplasm_charm.de: Cheats death once, leaving you at half health. Needs ten minutes to recover.
item.mod-stella-tower.tower_whetstone.de: Used up to turn a failed refine at an anvil into a success.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.appear: A wandering ghost merchant has come to the floor.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.tower_: The ghost merchant sells its goods only in the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.short: The ghost merchant wants %s emeralds. You carry %s.
